newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia government Dec jobs indicator falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia government Dec jobs indicator falls.

text.p: The Australian government's leading indicator of employment fell to minus 0.587 in December from minus 0.546 in November, the Employment Department said on Wednesday.
"The rate of decline in the indicator has been slowing since July 1996, suggesting a trough in the indicator may not be far away," the department said in a statement.
The indicator has fallen steadily every month since a slight rise in May.
The indicator combines seven other indicators, including vehicle registrations, housing approvals and official and private sector measures of job vacancies.
It has been shown to lead employment changes consistently over the long term.
